# cdnpro_log_config (Resource)

A CDN Pro access log download configuration (`/cdn/report/logConfigs`). The API's integer ID is carried as a string.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cdnpro_log_config" "main" {
  description = "Standard access logs for example-site"
  hostnames   = ["www.example.com", "example.com"]

  log_download_storage_days      = 30
  log_download_file_span_minutes = 60
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostnames` (List of String) Hostnames whose logs are collected. Wildcards and a lone `*` are accepted.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `log_download_file_span_minutes` (Number)
- `log_download_format` (String) Log line template using `%name` / `%{name}` variables. Defaults to the API's Apache-style combined format.
- `log_download_storage_days` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_update_time` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The API's integer ID is used as a string.
terraform import cdnpro_log_config.main 4427
```
